title: Mississippi Officer Who Fatally Shot Toddler Had a History of Aggressive Policing
summary: A new examination of video footage shows that the officer who shot at a fleeing car in a Walmart parking lot, killing a boy, had previously ramped up encounters by punching, cursing and drawing his weapon.
